name: publicWeb_getRunPhotoPins
description: Where and when each Hash-Flash-approved PUBLIC photo of a run was taken, for the public PackTrack map and Trail TV pins. Unauthenticated (no device or token). Photos are no longer written into GPS tracks, so maps read pins from HC.KennelPhotos rows. Exposure is the audience model's Public (3) and Cover (5) photos only — the same coordinates the track payload used to carry as PHO:: marks; the gallery endpoint (publicWeb_getRunPhotos) still returns no coordinates.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: The run's public id. NULL returns EventFound = 0 and no second rowset.

rowsets.name: EventFound
rowsets.description: Always one row. 1 if any HC.Event has this PublicEventId (deleted/removed runs included), else 0. When @publicEventId is NULL this is the only rowset.

rowsets.name: Pins
rowsets.description: Photos with Status >= 3, DeletedAt IS NULL and a real coordinate (not NULL, not 0,0), ordered by COALESCE(TakenAtUtc, CreatedAt) ascending. Returned only when @publicEventId is not NULL.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: KennelPhotos.Latitude — where the photo was taken

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: KennelPhotos.Longitude — where the photo was taken

columns.name: TakenAtUtc
columns.description: When it was taken (UTC); NULL on rows before 2026-09-07 — callers fall back to CreatedAt

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never return photos below Status 3 from this unauthenticated endpoint
